text: Blinatumomab (Blincyto), an anti-CD19/anti-CD3 bi-specific T cell engager
Blinatumomab is a novel single chain antibody construct in the class of the bispecific T-cell engager (BiTE).
ATG-201 is a recombinant, human IgG1-like TCE that simultaneously binds to human CD3 and CD19.
CC312, a trispecific CD19-targeting co-stimulatory T cell engager, for the treatment of B cell malignancies
TCE-A: An OR-gate CD19xCD20xCD3 trispecific T-cell engager for B-cell malignancies
Teclistamab is a BCMAxCD3 bispecific T-cell engager (BiTE) administered via subcutaneous injection.
